### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior Backend Engineer building Spotify’s backend systems for personalized podcast recommendations. Designing scalable ranking, retrieval, and data pipelines for millions of listeners.
Senior Backend Engineer building Spotify podcast recommendation infrastructure
Role description:
• Architect, build, and evolve backend systems supporting personalization and recommendations at Spotify scale
• Design reliable, scalable, and performant services for high-volume recommendation workloads
• Build and improve infrastructure and pipelines to retrieve, rank, and deliver personalized podcast recommendations
• Partner with Product Managers, Engineers, Data Scientists, and Designers to develop recommendation experiences and define experimentation strategies
• Own backend systems through technical design, implementation, deployment, monitoring, and continued improvement
• Use experimentation and data to assess system changes and inform future development
• Navigate ambiguous technical problems and contribute to the long-term architecture of personalization systems
• Share knowledge and engineering practices with teammates
Role requirements:
• Experience building production systems with Java
• Experience designing distributed, high-volume services
• Experience deploying, operating, and evolving services in production
• Experience working directly with stakeholders to understand requirements
• Experience designing broadly adoptable APIs and systems
• Strong understanding of system design, data structures, and algorithms
• Interest in large-scale data processing technologies
• Comfort working in an environment where teams experiment, learn, and iterate quickly
• Use of data to inform technical and product decisions
• Experience with technologies such as gRPC, GCP, BigQuery, Bigtable, or similar tools and platforms
• Ability to work within the Eastern Standard time zone for collaboration

• Paid flexible holidays

BigQuery, Google Cloud Platform, GRPC, Java
